methods.name: create
methods.desc:
Deploy. `testnet_skip_online_check` is a TESTNET-ONLY flag (immutable after
creation) that skips the online-consensus-participant check so the flow can be tested without running a participation node. It is rejected on MainNet.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.desc: Create the root ring buffer and per-tier leaf counters (admin only).

methods.name: post_root
methods.desc:
Root updater posts the root of tier `tier`'s tree over its first
`leaf_count` leaves (rebuilt off-chain from LeafDeposited events).

methods.name: deposit_commitment
methods.desc:
Cold wallet (online consensus node) deposits an opaque leaf
Poseidon(secret, nullifier, tier) into the `declared_tier` tree. Returns the leaf index inside that tier's tree.

events.name: LeafDeposited
events.desc: ARC-28 event consumed by the off-chain Merkle indexer.

methods.name: claim_status
methods.desc:
Hot wallet claims a tier status with a Groth16 proof of membership.
public_inputs = nullifierHash || publicTier || root || hotWalletHi || hotWalletLo (5 x 32-byte big-endian BN254 scalars, snarkjs order).

methods.name: reveal_public_profile
methods.desc:
OPT-IN public link hot -> cold (for leaderboards / public profiles).
The MBR payment must be signed by `cold_address` itself, proving the caller controls that cold wallet (otherwise anyone could claim a whale's address). This only *publishes* a link; it grants no authority over either account.

methods.name: hide_public_profile
methods.desc:
Remove the public link; the box MBR is refunded to the cold wallet that paid it.
(Historical transactions remain visible on-chain forever.)
